subject: Legacy invoice reconciliation & consolidated billing plan — North Ridge Labs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northridgelabs.com>, North Ridge Labs Billing <billing@northridgelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Legacy invoice reconciliation & consolidated billing plan — North Ridge Labs

Hi Elena / NR Billing team,

Congrats again on the close — glad to have you all onboard. As we transition billing into a single Redwood account, finance needs a short reconciliation of legacy invoices and confirmation of the target remit details so we can: 1) stop duplicate invoices, 2) consolidate outstanding balances onto the post-close master account, and 3) ensure VAT/tax information maps correctly.

Would you please provide the following by EOD Thursday (04/08)?
- A list of any unpaid invoices to North Ridge Labs (invoice #, original date, currency, net amount, VAT if applicable)
- The legal entity name and tax ID that should appear on future Redwood invoices
- Preferred remit address and any changes to ACH/wire routing or AP contact email
- Any purchase order or AR workflow we should route to (PO number format, contact)

Attached is our quick export of what our billing system shows as outstanding on the legacy account — it may not align perfectly with your AP ledger. If you can send an archive of issued invoices (PDFs or a CSV) we will reconcile and propose a single credit/charge schedule to net things out.

Attachment: NRL_outstanding_invoices_20270405.csv (stub)

Happy to jump on a short call if that helps — propose 30m Thursday at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales (Billing lead for NRL transition)
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northridgelabs.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 13:46:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Legacy invoice reconciliation & consolidated billing plan — North Ridge Labs

Hi Jordan — thanks and congrats to everyone.

Quick answers below and attaching what our AP team exported this morning.

- Unpaid invoices: See attached archive (NRL_invoice_archive.zip). Most items are in USD; a small subset (EMEA customers) were billed GBP and carry VAT treatments.
- Legal entity for future invoices: "North Ridge Labs, Inc." — US EIN: 12-3456789.
- Remit address (paper invoices): 120 Meridian Ave, 6th Floor, Boston, MA 02110.
- ACH details: we prefer ACH to our treasury bank; please coordinate with billing@northridgelabs.com for secure routing instructions.
- AP contact & PO workflow: billing@northridgelabs.com (please CC ar-ops@northridgelabs.com if any PO thresholds >$50k).

Note on VAT: For EMEA legacy customers, KPMG is assisting with VAT reclassifications post-close — cc'd so they can confirm if any retrospective VAT adjustments are required.

We also found two credits issued by our legacy payment gateway that didn't apply in your export; included in the archive are supporting PDFs per invoice.

Attachments: NRL_invoice_archive.zip (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northridgelabs.com>, North Ridge Labs Billing <billing@northridgelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Legacy invoice reconciliation & consolidated billing plan — North Ridge Labs

Thanks Elena — archive received. I pulled a preliminary mapping and there are three things to call out before we present a final schedule to NR AP: 

1) Duplicate gateway credits: Our export shows two refunds that never landed as applied credits; appears to be a timing mismatch between gateway and ledger. We'll recommend a netting of $21,450 against open invoices (detail in attached).
2) Currency/VAT: For the EMEA subset, we need the VAT registration number for the EU entity — KPMG please confirm whether NR will treat these as supplied under the legacy regime or migrate VAT to Redwood going forward.
3) Cutover effective date: propose May 1, 2027 for all new invoices to be issued under "North Ridge Labs, Inc." on Redwood invoices. Any invoices dated before May 1 will be reconciled and either credited or billed in the legacy bucket.

Next steps I propose: finance team will create a proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx and route to Elena + KPMG for sign-off; once approved, Redwood will apply netting in our AR system and issue a single consolidated invoice for any remaining balance. Please confirm if NR can approve the May 1 cutover and the netting approach.

Attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx (stub)

Elena / team — thanks for the quick turn. We're aligned on the proposed approach and can proceed with the following deliverables this week:

1) Redwood will prepare the legal amendment for the billing entity change (one-page amendment capturing remittance update + effective date May 1, 2027). I'll route the DocuSign link to billing@northridgelabs.com once internal review is complete.
2) Marissa's team will finalize the credit schedule; we'll apply netting in AR the day the amendment is signed.
3) KPMG, please confirm whether any retrospective VAT adjustments require a separate journal/credit memo in Redwood's system or if they should be reflected as adjustments on the consolidated invoice.

For transparency, HubSpot deal id: NLR-2987 (link above). Once amendment is signed we'll update the customer record and swap billing to the master account.

Jordan — please confirm you can share the DocuSign link and the final amendment copy today so Elena's AP can review.

Thanks,
